Amounts use integer USD cents. Read-only enquiries and preparation of instructions do not advance the service clock. The customer approves each exact prepared instruction before execution. Repeating the same executed request returns its receipt; a different request is a separate instruction. Deadlines are inclusive. A requested bank update advances to the next scheduled event, whose results become available when it occurs. A final outward payment, disclosure, original deletion or commercial settlement cannot be reversed through this service. No additional funding is available beyond the facilities and receipts recorded for the case. The action references specify the accepted data fields.
# Cargo claim, evidence custody and replacement-goods funding
The claims desk will publish the actual issue at the evidence-request event. A recipient_acceptance issue requires the order-reference field and the original evidence whose evidence_purpose is recipient_acceptance. A device_integrity issue instead requires the order-reference field and the evidence whose evidence_purpose is device_integrity. The request does not authorize unrelated personal information. The full amount, low-evidence amount and timing are recorded in the claim.
Each retention_basis is a separate obligation over its field_refs. An active basis requires the listed original fields to remain present. A basis ends only at its own end_event; one basis ending does not release another. The claim_award event ends claim retention for every listed field. At that event, the evidence actually requested by the desk joins the domestic audit basis if its original is present or original_required remains in force. The independent audit_release event ends that audit basis. A basis with no end_event continues beyond this episode. A field with no active basis and no outstanding custody pledge must be deleted in the current business window: at window 0 if initially unprotected, or in the same window in which its last protection ends. Delete is irreversible and technically available even if it breaches an active retention obligation.
The domestic evidence-custody advance may be drawn once by draw_deadline. It credits principal_minor and charges fee_minor. One available original with collateral_eligible=true must be pledged. While any principal remains outstanding, the pledged original must be retained and its content must not be copied to the foreign claims desk. The pledge is separate from claim and audit retention. substitute_collateral replaces the pledge with another available eligible original and charges substitution_fee_minor each time; it does not advance the clock or repay debt. repay may repay positive parts of the outstanding principal. Full repayment releases the pledge, and the entire advance must be repaid by repay_deadline. Repaid principal does not reopen the drawing facility.
An early commercial settlement credits early_settlement_minor immediately and extinguishes the right to any later claim award. It is available only before claim submission or final disposition. Issuance of the advance does not itself settle or submit a claim.
export records the exact listed fields and their content as a permanent external copy. The tool can copy any present original, but compliance depends on the actual issue, the custody pledge and any recorded scope waiver; subsequent deletion or loan repayment cannot erase an earlier disclosure. Before the formal request there is no authority for claim disclosure. Domestic retention alone is not authority to disclose abroad. A recorded broad-scope waiver extends the disclosure restriction; it does not remove retention obligations. Otherwise only the two purpose-matching fields may be copied, and an outstanding pledged field remains confidential when collateral_confidential is in force.
submit_claim names unique field IDs that have actually been exported, before the award event. A non-settled submitted claim receives full_minor at claim_award only if both purpose-matching fields were exported after the request and their originals remained available until award when original_required is in force. Otherwise it receives low_evidence_minor; a claim not submitted receives nothing. The award is final. When original_required is not in force, a field protected solely by the claim basis can be deleted after a valid export without reducing the award; an absent field does not acquire a new audit basis under that exception. Loan, audit and continuing statutory protections are unaffected by it.
The replacement deposit and dispatch balance are separate registered obligations. pay records a final payment from available cash; it does not discharge the loan or alter a retention basis.
Unlock `propose_claim_retention`.
| Action | Data keys | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| borrow | record_id, collateral_id | Draw the recorded advance against an eligible original and pay its fee. |
| substitute_collateral | record_id, collateral_id | Replace the outstanding pledge and pay the substitution fee. |
| repay | record_id, amount_minor | Repay outstanding advance principal. |
| accept_settlement | record_id | Receive the early amount and surrender the remaining claim rights. |
| delete | record_id | Irreversibly delete one original field. |
| export | record_ids | Record an external copy of the listed present originals. |
| submit_claim | record_ids | Submit previously exported fields before the award. |
| pay | record_id, amount_minor | Pay a registered replacement-goods obligation. |

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_claim_retention`

Prepare a original-evidence secured advance, collateral substitution, repayment, claim settlement, evidence export, claim submission, original deletion or replacement-goods payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
